segments.summary: Reviewed all controls from Show Terminal through the final info-icon row. The segment establishes concept-fixture and owner-adjudicated boundaries, identifies repeated accessibility defects, exposes destructive recovery actions as uncontracted demos, and defines owner acceptance plus production wiring evidence as the promotion oracle.

Reviewed the problems footer, message controls, info icon, root source binding, source evidence references, final GUI ownership map, fixture dispositions, and toolchain currentness. The segment preserves PMConcept as source lineage only, routes authority to owner documents, rejects mock statuses and sensitive-looking fixture values as production evidence, and leaves unwired control semantics explicitly unresolved for production owners.
